section_summary.extract_value: This section details a study investigating the factor structure of creativity measures and their relationship with semantic distance variables and intelligence. The study found positive correlations among creative cognition, production, and achievement measures. A principal-axis factoring analysis on divergent thinking, story writing, Torrance figural tests, and the CAQ yielded a single 'creativity factor' accounting for 42.46% of the variance. Multiple regression analysis indicated that cued semantic distance predicted creativity (ß = .50) even after controlling for WAIS total scores, RAPM accuracy, and BFAS openness scores.

section_summary.extract_value: This section details a study investigating the factor structure of creativity measures and the discriminant validity of a cued creativity variant of a verb generation task. It found positive correlations among creative cognition, production, and achievement measures, leading to the extraction of a single creativity factor. Multiple regression analyses indicated that cued semantic distance predicted creativity, even after controlling for intelligence (WAIS total scores, RAPM accuracy) and personality, suggesting its unique association with the creativity factor.
